method: Learn two 8-step latent native-action motion models and two action-blind body/disc box fields at 0.16 and 0.32s. Read both option trajectories in the same field from each onset. Distill XY, vulnerability and separate body/disc contact contrasts at both horizons into a 10-column projection of the frozen native encoder. Use randomized real rewards to fit the switch. No observational immediate damage predictor selects actions.
selection: World weights and feature projection use old development training trajectories only. In held, actually randomized, four-key descent trials require lower assigned-arm than swapped-arm horizontal-error mean and in a majority of at least four held games. For the newer 24 compound games, fit only 18 designated train games. On six previously designated holdout games require positive four-second reward in >=4 games and on average, a majority with fewer actual masks and lower mean masks, nonnegative mean eight-second reward and nonnegative four- and eight-second boss output. Fresh 100-fight original conditions are the final acceptance. Keep the previously registered random-projection controller as a separate comparison; the six development games are shared.
historical_behavior: The descent randomizer used H. Verify its frozen native export against the original actor checksum before interpreting either randomized arm. Predict H logits for the continuation in the old held experiment. Use T for the later compound experiment.
